summary: The note describes Genesis Motors, the luxury vehicle division of South Korean manufacturer Hyundai Motor Group. It explains that the brand was first envisioned in 2004 alongside Hyundai's luxury sedan Hyundai Genesis, and was officially announced as a standalone marque on 4 November 2015.
one_line: Genesis Motors is the luxury vehicle division of Hyundai Motor Group, conceived in 2004 and launched as a standalone brand in 2015.
key_facts: Genesis Motors is the luxury vehicle division of the South Korean vehicle manufacturer Hyundai Motor Group.
The Genesis brand was initially envisioned along with the plan for Hyundai's new luxury sedan Hyundai Genesis in 2004.
The Genesis brand was officially announced as a standalone marque on 4 November 2015.
